name: my-postgres

info.notes:
PostgreSQL can be accessed via port 5432 on the following DNS name from within your cluster:
my-postgres-postgresql.prod.svc.cluster.local

manifest:
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: my-postgres
  namespace: prod
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: my-postgres
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 1
